title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content: Indoor experiment using bumble bees (Bombus ignitus) and artificial flowers. The worker gathers sugar solution from an artificial “flower” made of a transparent acrylic jar with a circular-coloured paper attached to the inside. Image by Kentaro Takagi and Kazuharu Ohashi. For full details see pages 863–875.
